entries.title: Open-bed Utility Pickup
entries.description: Original S01 static utility pickup with a genuinely separate two-seat cab and open-top empty cargo bed. Cabin has actual open window apertures, supported seats, dashboard and a fixed steering visual; no glazing is claimed. The low-walled bed has a real interior floor, front bulkhead and fixed closed tailgate. Four finite-contact tyres, hubs, axles, hangers, chassis rails and floor bearers form actual support chains. Metre scale, source Z up, front -Y, origin at ground under the wheelbase centre. Five solid PBR materials and named editable closed components. One fixed parked visual prop; no driving, steering, opening tailgate or doors, animation, cargo capacity, loading fit, roadworthiness, collision, physics, stability, load or engineering certification.

entries.title: Village Residential Street Scene
entries.description: One static residential street scene, zero new standalone models. Four fixed exterior porch cottages face a nine-tile soil lane, with 2mm real road seams, straight members from the narrow stone border kit, eight detached complete fence panels and two orchard trees. Unit-scale original geometry and full solid PBR are preserved. Border corner member is not included. Requires external flat Z0 ground. Original door leaves remain fixed; no enterable interior, navigation, collision-controller, accessibility or building safety certification.

entries.title: Railway Maintenance Workbench Wagon
entries.description: Original static railway maintenance wagon with a fixed rear workbench attached through four legs to a broad deck. Two genuinely open-front storage compartments have a solid shelf, side walls, divider and back. A rear toolboard holds a recognisable fixed hammer, open-jaw spanner and screwdriver on solid mounts; the forward deck remains visibly open as a work area. The tabletop is clear and every component has a physical static support path. Metres, source Z up, long axis Y; flange-bottom origin. Four tread centres X plus/minus .54 m, Y plus/minus .76 m; local tread bottom Z=.04 m. Place at Z=.16 m on the original 1.00 m clear-gauge track with head top Z=.20 m. Four solid PBR materials, named editable components, no external source dependency. This work station is different from the existing hand-push toolbox trolley and empty freight flatbed. Static visual prop only; no driving, braking, lifting, animated wheels, tool operation, dynamic coupling, human occupancy, load capacity, physics, engineering, railway safety or regulatory certification.

entries.title: Deep Rectangular Photography Softbox
entries.description: Original static photography softbox with a genuinely deep tapered hollow rectangular hood, closed inset front diffusion panel, rear lamp-head housing and a fixed U-shaped mounting yoke. The head has a real continuous support path through its pivot, yoke, mast, hub and three grounded feet. Five restrained solid PBR materials and separately named closed editable components; no external source dependencies. Metres, source Z up, front -Y, ground origin (0,0,0), mast axis Y=.19 m. Distinct from the existing thin octagonal reflector. One reusable static prop only; no emitted light, optical or electrical simulation, physical light power, animated tilt or folding, engineering, load-bearing, balance, stability or safety certification.

entries.title: Timber Treadle Spinning Wheel
entries.description: Original static timber spinning wheel with a large eight-spoke open driving wheel, separate solid axle and two supporting posts. A broad sloped treadle connects through an offset crank pin and diagonal connecting rod. A side-mounted winding spindle has two bearing posts, a small pulley, two flanges and a cream wound-yarn sleeve; a real closed cord loop follows the wheel and pulley. The eight spoke apertures, lateral wheel clearances, raised wheel bottom and treadle clearance are real geometry. All named parts have physical fixed-pose support routes to two long grounded feet. Metres, source Z up, wheel and spindle axes Y, ground-centre origin; four solid PBR materials, separate editable source components and no external dependencies. Distinct yarn preparation prop, not a loom or a loose spool tray. Static visual game asset only; no spinning animation, working transmission, cloth simulation, torque, human ergonomics, engineering or safety certification.

entries.title: Chambered Fossil Section
entries.description: Original stylized spiral-shell fossil section with a thick irregular stone matrix and broad directly grounded cut bottom. A continuous expanding solid shell wall and 22 separate thick curved septa bound a sequence of genuinely recessed chambers. The pale planar shell faces, darker chamber floors and rough faceted outer rind are actual closed meshes with solid PBR materials; no image, procedural texture or painted fossil pattern is used. The shell walls project 0.15 m above the recessed stone floor and are embedded into the matrix. Metres, Z-up native source, front facing -Y. Named editable parts and self-contained generator. This single specimen differs from the existing five-prism crystal cluster and unsectioned raw minerals. Static artistic collection prop; no real species identification, scientific anatomical reconstruction, dating, geological accuracy, physical conservation, load, stability or safety certification.

entries.title: Submerged Sediment Shoal
entries.description: Original S02 local riverbed-rise shoal over a 2 m straight run. A real asymmetric faceted sediment lens raises the bed from Z=.09 to .135 m under one connected flat water surface at Z=.16 m, leaving at least .025 m water depth. The separate closed water body has a bed-conforming bottom in actual opposed contact with the raised terrain; this is not a dry bank, flat shallow-stream recolour or exposed sediment island. Both ends match the actual existing width-transition narrow terrain cap union: bank feet Y=+/- .30, raw water edges Y=+/- .36, end planes X=-1/+1 m. Old west placement Rz=180 degrees plus (-2,0,0) m; east placement +(2,0,0) m. Water bottom cap edges retreat .01 m, retaining the old paired .02 m bottom V gap. Only surface continuity is claimed; terrain finite-area cap contact and water top-edge/tangent compatibility are verified separately. Visible end-adjacent earth/water PBR stays legacy-identical. Hidden single terrain caps do not reproduce the old separated bed/bank cap material partition. Only interior ShoalWater uses alpha BLEND opacity .28, base RGB (.70,.82,.78), zero transmission, roughness0 and glTF-default IOR1.5 as a non-refracting stylized static material, not real water optics. Other materials stay opaque. Transparent face sorting remains renderer-dependent and is bounded by the supplied runtime checks; sediment is real editable topology underneath. One continuous closed terrain mesh and one separate closed water mesh, no decorative stones or props. No exact bend, whole-scene or cliff-side snap. Static visual only; no animated flow, hydrology, fluid volume continuity, collision, navigation, wading safety or physics certification.

entries.title: Fixed-Open Laboratory Benchtop Centrifuge
entries.description: Original compact static benchtop centrifuge visual prop with a thick chamfered enclosure, genuine blind-bottom circular chamber, centrally supported eight-well rotor and eight real deep blind receiving cavities. Fixed open thick lid, inset seal ring, two bored hinge supports and a polygonal pin resting on actual finite bearing facets. Independent controls and four grounded feet. Five solid PBR materials; closed separately editable components. Metres, source Z up, front -Y, ground origin (0,0,0). No sample tubes or compatibility with the existing sample rack are claimed. No rotor or lid animation, continuous motion, laboratory procedure, diagnosis, speed, electrical, load, stability or safety certification.

entries.title: Open Pocket Training Football Goal
entries.description: Original static low-poly freestanding football training goal with two warm ivory front posts and a real open crossbar mouth. A muted teal return base, side shoulders, diagonal back stays and rear cross-members form a deep grounded frame. A sparse sand-coloured solid-rope net wraps the roof, sloped back and both trapezoidal sides, leaving the whole front open. Every rope has two physically joined support ends and every named component connects to four finite flat foot pads. The net openings and front-mouth clearance are real empty geometry. Approximate 3 m wide by 2 m high visual proportions, metres, source Z up, front faces -Y and ground-centre origin; four solid PBR materials, editable parts and no external dependencies. Distinct independent ground goal, not a scaled table-football pocket or a single flat divider net. Static game visual only; no regulation dimensions, net dynamics, playable ball collision, anchoring, tipping resistance, wind loading or safety certification.

entries.title: Tilted Open Drum Concrete Mixer
entries.description: Original static low-poly small concrete mixer with an ochre pear-shaped thick drum, a genuinely open narrowed mouth, deep interior and three solid wall-rooted paddles. A rear drum spindle sits on a U-shaped tilting cradle with two horizontal trunnions seated on finite lower facets of true bored side bearings. A separate open handwheel, three spokes, rear motor shroud, braced teal chassis, solid axle, two faceted wheels and two flat front feet complete the independent assembly. All editable closed components connect through actual joints to finite ground patches. One fixed tilted pose, four solid PBR materials, metres, source Z up, ground-centre origin and front -Y. No texture or external asset. Distinct from a horizontal sealed garden composter. Static game visual only: no mixing performance, drum rotation, tilt animation, pour trajectory, complete mechanical drive, electrical operation, load, stability or construction-safety certification.

entries.title: Carved Four-String Violin
entries.description: Original static low-poly single violin lying on a finite flat back. A warm amber waisted body has a real hollow rib cavity and two cut-through f-shaped soundholes. Four individual solid strings run from a supported tailpiece across a two-foot arched bridge and a fretless curved ebony fingerboard to the nut and four alternate-sided pegs in an open pegbox. A carved spiral scroll, honey maple neck, fine purfling rim, tail saddle, button and paired tailgut complete the single editable instrument. All named components are physically connected to the grounded backplate; actual cavity, f-hole apertures, string/fingerboard clearance and bridge-foot support are checked. Approximately 0.67 m long visual proportions; metres, source Z up, scroll toward +Y and origin at the ground projection of the body centre. Six solid PBR materials, no textures or external dependencies. Distinct violin anatomy, not a reduced six-string fretted guitar. Static game visual only; no bow, case, stand, sound, animation, playability, instrument-size accuracy or safety certification.

entries.title: Sit-Down Arcade Racer
entries.description: Original single static low-poly sit-down arcade racing machine on a continuous chamfered ground base. An orange deep bucket seat has a reclined back, side bolsters and enclosed lower support. An open footwell leads to two separate inclined fixed pedals on real struts. A three-spoke tilted steering ring is attached by a shaft to a separate console with two base-supported inclined legs. A broad framed blank screen pod is supported by the front cabinet. Screen_Runtime is an exclusive named mesh with its own Runtime screen exclusive solid PBR material, ready for content replacement by a consuming application. Teal shell, coral upholstery, dark rubber and pale bezel remain separately editable; all components have actual interior support witnesses leading to the shared base. Finite seat, lap and foot-approach volumes are geometrically empty; the geometry is not a human-fit guarantee. Metres, source Z up, rider facing +Y, origin at ground projection of base centre. Seven solid PBR materials, no textures or external dependencies. Static game visual only: no game content, trademarks, networking, input device, steering/pedal action, driving physics, human fit, load or amusement-equipment safety certification.

entries.title: Brass Arc Navigation Sextant
entries.description: Original static low-poly navigation sextant with an open fan-shaped brass framework, separate dark graduation arc and 61 physical scale marks, a fixed pivot-connected index arm and arc shoe, two distinct supported silver mirror plates in U-shaped seats, a short supported sighting tube and a rear wooden grip. Four radial ribs and an inner arch form six real cut-through framework windows. Two integral compact display feet support the arc. All named components connect through actual finite interior overlaps to grounded feet; handle/frame and tube/frame clearance are checked. Six flat solid PBR materials, no textures or external resources. Metres, native Z up, front -Y and ground origin at centre. One original reusable instrument, distinct from the earlier compass, map table and telescope. Static stylized visual only: no optical-path validity, angular measurement, calibration, navigation, moving mechanism, stability or safety certification.

entries.title: Sidecut Alpine Ski Pair
entries.description: One original low-poly alpine ski pair counted as one static prop. Two long continuous closed boards have genuine wide shovels, narrow waists, flared tails, variable thickness, upturned tapered tips and gently lifted tail ends. Each ski has separate mounted toe and heel rail plates, a shaped toe housing with two solid retaining wings, a low toe sole pad, a tall heel housing, forward heel clamp, heel sole pad, fixed release lever, pivot and two bent raised brake arms. The measured empty space between the bindings is a visual boot bay, not a fit or release specification. Teal tops, dark bases, pale steel sidewalls and cream inlaid geometric marks use four constant solid PBR materials. Named closed editable meshes, actual finite flat sole support and connected binding components; source Z up, metres, ground-centre origin, tips -Y. One paired product, not two new models; no boots, poles, stand or external textures. Static artistic game visual only: no skiing, turning, snow interaction, binding release, wearable fit, brake operation, load or sports-safety certification.

entries.title: Pottery Loop Trimming Tool Kit
entries.description: One original static pottery trimming tool kit counted as one prop, not three new models. A circular loop, triangular loop and asymmetric curved kidney scraper each have a genuine cut-through opening, a closed thick ribbon blade, a bent solid metal tang, a hollow stepped ferrule and an individual turned walnut handle. The ferrule has a narrow tang bore and a wider handle socket; actual interior witnesses connect the blade, tang, collar and wood. Flat lower blade surfaces and finite flat grip facets rest on the ground in this one arranged display pose. Twelve named editable closed meshes use walnut, dark walnut, warm brass and pale steel constant solid PBR materials. Source Z up, metres, ground-centre origin, blade direction -Y; no external textures or separate display stand. Static stylized game visual only: no sharpness, cutting performance, grip ergonomics, material certification or real-world tool safety claim.

entries.title: Open Brass Pocket Watch
entries.description: Original static low-poly open pocket watch with a thick closed-back brass case, true recessed ivory dial, sixty separate physical markers, two separated blue-steel hands and a supported spindle, faceted winding crown and a genuine open bow. The shallow thick cover is fixed at 112 degrees on three individually bored hinge sleeves and an embedded axle, with finite case and cover mounting tongues. The flat circular back provides a finite ground-contact patch; all mesh components connect to it. No separate stand or chain is included. Six flat solid PBR materials, no images or textures. Metres, native Z up, dial +Z, front -Y and origin at ground below case centre. One original reusable prop, distinct from the old open-frame pendulum clock and sundial. Static stylized visual only: no timekeeping, calibration, clockwork, water resistance, precious-metal value, wearability, moving-cover or safety claim.

entries.title: Meadow Single-seat A-frame Swing
entries.description: Original static low-poly single-seat swing with two sage A-shaped end frames, four finite ground shoes, an ivory crossbeam, side ties and four diagonal knee braces. Two fixed metal beam collars and downward rope ferrules support long sand-coloured ropes; each divides through a lower ferrule into two short bridle ropes attached to four physical seat brackets on a single coral seat plank. The complete support route is real closed geometry and every named part connects to the four ground shoes. The seated central space, seat-to-frame and under-seat clearances are checked on actual triangles in this one rest pose. Five solid PBR materials; metre units, native Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. One independently reusable playground prop, distinct from the earlier pivoted seesaw, slide, picnic bench, clothesline and rigid footbridge. No person, extra scenery, textures or external dependencies. Fixed stylized game visual only: no swinging, rope dynamics, animation, load rating, anchoring, tipping resistance, fall-zone or entrapment compliance, engineering, playground or child-safety certification.

entries.title: Twin-Rim Paddle Water Wheel
entries.description: Original static water wheel with two thick open timber rims, eight radial spokes per side, a broad solid hub and a Y-axis shaft. Sixteen broad radial paddle boards span the wheel width and seat into both rims, giving visible water-receiving faces. Two outboard A-frame stands support closed annular bearing sleeves; each has a real central bore with a small fixed seated shaft overlap. Two broad flat feet and low cross-ties form one connected grounded assembly. Real spoke apertures, wheel-to-frame side clearance and raised paddle bottom. Four solid PBR materials, separately named closed editable meshes, source Z up, metres and ground-centre origin. One reusable prop including necessary supports. Distinct water-receiving geometry, not a recolored spinning wheel; no mill building, water channel, belt, generator, external textures or third-party marks. One checked static pose only: no rotation, water flow, hydrodynamics, energy generation, transmission, bearing function, loading, engineering or safety certification.

entries.title: Tilted-Axis Classroom Globe
entries.description: One original static stylized desktop globe with a closed faceted spherical shell, simplified continent-shaped material regions on the same shell, a 23.5-degree tilted polar axis, two separate pole pins and genuinely bored bearing sleeves, a thick open meridian ring, short turned column and finite flat circular base. Eight named closed editable meshes form an actual interior-witness support chain from the globe to the base; the spherical surface has measured clearance from the meridian frame. The globe has its own centre pivot and explicit polar-axis direction. Only the supplied static orientation is checked; no rotation range or controller is promised. Metres, native Z up, ground-centre origin, front -Y. Five solid PBR materials, no textures, markings, labels or external assets. Simplified sea/land regions are visual illustration, not accurate geographic, navigation, astronomical or measurement data; no teaching outcome or product-safety claim.

entries.title: Long Rail Rowing Machine
entries.description: Original static low-poly indoor rowing machine with a 1.84m longitudinal rail, independent chamfered saddle and a captured four-roller carriage. Two upper rollers and two lower capture rollers engage the rail in one stored pose; external carrier cheeks have actual lateral clearance, with physical front and rear stops. Two inclined foot trays have raised heel edges and true open arch straps. A separate transverse pull handle rests on a solid cradle and connects to the front resistance enclosure by a fixed cord. The front unit has a thick annular enclosure, separately editable inner wheel, radial protective grilles, central hub and bearing-style caps. Front and rear crossfeet terminate in four finite ground pads. Six solid flat PBR materials, no textures, characters or imported seat geometry. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, origin on the ground under rail centreline. One original reusable prop. Static stylized visual only: no exercise prescription, body-fit guarantee, resistance/power specification, continuous sliding/rope controller, load rating or safety certification.

entries.title: Crimped Paint Tube Kit
entries.description: One original static paint-tube kit counted as one prop: three differently compressed soft-metal tubes with integral sloping shoulders, modeled hollow necks, finite folded crimp tails and ribbed screw-cap forms. Two caps are fitted over the necks; the third tube is open with a real visible bore and blind internal cavity, and its separate cap rests upright on a finite annular rim beside the set. Muted blue, ochre and vermilion bands are assigned to the body faces, not duplicate overlay surfaces, brands or text labels. Each tube has a finite flat lower body facet and its crimp joins the solid tail region; all components are supported in one arranged rest pose. Nine named editable closed meshes, six constant solid PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. No paint-flow, squeezing, cap animation, chemical composition, usable quantity, sealing, toxicity, painting performance or manufacturing guarantee.
